```yaml
name: Clean Unused L10n Strings

on:
  schedule:
    # Run on the first day of every month at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies (if any)
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true

      - name: Detect unused L10n strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.json
          echo "unused_count=$(jq -r '.count' unused_strings.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post comment on PR
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('unused_strings.json', 'utf8'));
            const body = `⚠️ **Unused L10n strings detected**\n\nCount: ${data.count}\n\n${data.details.map(d => `- ${d}`).join('\n')}`;
            const { owner, repo, number } = context.issue;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: number,
              body
            });
            // Add a label to indicate cleanup is needed
            await github.issues.addLabels({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: number,
              labels: ['needs cleanup']
            });

  clean-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies (if any)
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true

      - name: Detect unused L10n strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.json
          echo "unused_count=$(jq -r '.count' unused_strings.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Remove unused strings
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py unused_strings.json

      - name: Set up SwiftGen
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        uses: swiftgen/SwiftGen@v1.0
        with:
          swiftgen-version: '6.5.0'

      - name: Regenerate Strings.swift
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        run: swiftgen strings

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          git push origin HEAD:cleanup-unused-strings

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const branch = 'cleanup-unused-strings';
            const title = 'chore: remove unused L10n strings';
            const body = 'This PR removes unused localization strings detected by the automated workflow.';
            const { data: existing } = await github.pulls.list({
              owner,
              repo,
              head: `${owner}:${branch}`,
              base: 'main'
            });
            if (existing.data.length === 0) {
              await github.pulls.create({
                owner,
                repo,
                title,
                head: branch,
                base: 'main',
                body
              });
            }
```
